rounding_rule: order = (sum of the 7 daily forecasts) x (1 + buffer), rounded to the nearest whole unit, an exact half rounded up (120.5 -> 121). Computed as floor(x + 0.5 + 1e-9): the tiny 1e-9 stops computer rounding noise (120.49999999999999) from turning a true half down.
tie_break_rule: lowest total cost on the 12 validation weeks; if several buffers tie, the one closest to 0; if still tied, the smaller one
simplifications: Weekly totals only: running out on a single day is ignored if the week's order covers the week's total.
Leftover stock is not carried into the next week; every week is judged on its own.
Costs (short 3 : over 1, plus 1:1 and 5:1) are assumptions, not measured.
One buffer per method, tuned on only 12 validation weeks (96 item-weeks); the tuned validation cost is optimistic (see leave_one_week_out_check).
